procedure: prospective implementation clarification before attention preflight or outcome access
query_scope: valid teacher-forced response queries at the declared raw pre-o_proj query heads

source_alignment.prompt: ordered exact-token SequenceMatcher alignment already frozen and tested for the project
source_alignment.unmatched_target_tokens: retain target V states but receive zero mass under a full pattern replacement

operators.pattern_patch_values_retained: copy the source post-softmax pattern on aligned valid key coordinates into a zero target-shaped causal row, renormalize only for mass lost at unaligned source coordinates, and multiply by unchanged target V states
operators.value_patch_pattern_retained: copy source V states only at aligned valid key coordinates and multiply by the unchanged target post-softmax pattern
operators.concept_span_qk: in a triggered target, set post-RoPE K states at exact concept-span tokens to zero and recompute response-query QK logits, softcap, causal masking, and softmax while retaining target V; because the normal target has no monitoring-prefix concept span, induction installs the exact response-head reverse of the paired triggered removal effect
operators.concept_span_ov: in a triggered target, set V states at exact concept-span tokens to zero while retaining the target pattern; because the normal target has no monitoring-prefix concept span, induction installs the exact response-head reverse of the paired triggered removal effect

grouped_query_rule: each query head uses its native grouped key/value head
path_rule: the resulting raw selected-head response tensor is evaluated under both ordinary downstream recomputation and the sealed frozen-write direct path
isolation_rule: unselected heads, undeclared source tokens, response IDs, masks, kernel shape, dtype installation path, and every undeclared frozen branch remain unchanged
interpretation_limit: concept-span QK and OV labels identify a causal attention channel under these exact removal/reverse-installation operators; they are not unique natural mediation effects
